_comment: Springer Pavilion — event catalogue + seat inventory.
Mews has no seat-map primitive: a Product has a price, not 50 numbered units.
So the SEAT GRID lives here (your ticketing layer) while Mews stays the source
of truth for the MONEY (the ticket Product) and the GUEST LINK (the reservation).
The seat labels are written onto the Mews order as `Notes` so the folio reads
`soldSeats` here is the seeded baseline shipped with the demo. Seats sold during
a session are layered on top in localStorage (see js/springer.js → inventory).
Nothing is written back to this file.
Seats withheld from sale — house/staff holds, comps, sightline kills.
Mews has no seat model, so this is the ticketing layer's own inventory,
exactly like soldSeats. Held seats are unavailable everywhere: greyed and
unclickable in the preview and in the picker, and excluded from the
'seats left' count. They are NOT recoverable by the 'Reset demo
inventory' button, which only clears what was sold in the browser.
Keyed by Mews ProductId for events read live from Mews, and by local
event id for the offline fallback catalogue below.

seatMap._comment: 3 rows (A–C) × two 5-seat blocks with a centre aisle = 30 seats.

events.title: Casablanca Under the Stars
events.description: The 1942 print, projected onto the pavilion's stone back-wall as the light goes off Puget Sound. Blankets and a cedar-smoke fire pit provided; the bar stays open through the credits.

events.title: The Cascades Chamber Quartet
events.description: An evening of Ravel and Debussy from the quartet in residence, played without amplification into the pavilion's open bowl.

events.title: Rear Window
events.description: Hitchcock's courtyard thriller, closing the summer season. Late-night espresso and cinnamon rolls from Mrs. Baker served at intermission.
